request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, piano, harp, strings, soft drums, uplifting and serene mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I have set the LORD always before me
Because he is at my right hand I will not be shaken
My heart is glad and my glory rejoices
My body also rests secure in his care

[Chorus]
You make known to me the path of life
In your presence there is fullness of joy
At your right hand are pleasures forevermore
I hold you close and I am not afraid

[Verse]
You will not abandon my soul to the grave
Nor let your faithful one see decay
My hope is bound to your steadfast love
You keep me safe through the darkest day

[Chorus]
You make known to me the path of life
In your presence there is fullness of joy
At your right hand are pleasures forevermore
I hold you close and I am not afraid

[Bridge]
No shadow can take hold of my spirit
Your right hand upholds me in every trial
I rest secure in the promise you gave
My body and soul find peace in your arms

[Chorus]
You make known to me the path of life
In your presence there is fullness of joy
At your right hand are pleasures forevermore
I hold you close and I am not afraid

[Outro]
In your presence there is fullness of joy
Pleasures forevermore at your right hand
